about: Shared table for release validation (schema/README.md, 'Rules'). Each case edits a copy of the fixture release (fixtures/public) and names the exact set of issue codes both validators must report; an empty set means the edited release is still valid. Run by tests/v2/test_release.py and packages/core/src/release/release.test.ts. Steps: set / delete at a JSON path in a file; remove_file; move_file; copy_file; raw (replace a file's text); rename_release (the directory name). After the steps the harness refreshes the sha256 of every manifest row whose file still exists (and its vintages_sha256, when the row has one and the vintage file exists), unless the case says rehash: false.

a version's dates are its Period's
versions are in Period order

a Period has one current version at most
a version is not replaced before it was first held

a version's Channel is the one its metadata names
the versions current now are the series file's Observations: a different value is refused
the versions current now are the series file's Observations: a value with no current version is refused
a superseded version may say anything the Origin once said

a version the Origin did not date has no provider precision
a version is not superseded before the Origin published it
the Origin's record does not end before it begins

a Capture's scope does not end before it begins
recorded metadata holds only the fields the contract names
a vintage file is never in the legacy representation
a legacy Series has no vintage file (local profile, where a legacy Series may be)
a release of the contract before vintages (0.1.0) is still read
a 0.1.0 release cannot hold a vintage file: that version does not name it
one metadata hash names one metadata: a second, different one under the same hash is refused
